_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil base rate (0% directional move in 54 of 54 windows) demands HOLD with conviction unless a concrete breaker emerges — the analyst's invalidation conditions (funding flush below 30 with reserves dropping, or DXY below 98 with ETF flows above 90 and btc_dom_fade above 60) are the only signals that would justify a directional call.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing statistical honesty; narrative implies a bullish setup without explicitly calling direction, creating a split between structural caution and sentiment-driven optimism
next_move.confirmed_if: Funding rates flush below 30 with exchange reserves dropping (capitulation breaker) OR DXY cracks below 98 with ETF flows sustaining above 90 and btc_dom_fade accelerating above 60 (risk-on breakout)
next_move.invalidated_if: Score drops below 32 (Panic territory) indicating the coil is unwinding downward with macro stress intensifying, or gold/VIX divergence widens further breaking the accumulation thesis entirely
